\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 269-271 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:MR-R275-first-pass-words-from-chapters-269-271}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for dance and a stage.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a lid, a jar, a spiced lentil curry, a sprouted-bean curry, a pickle
  \item almonds, raisins, jaggery, a dhoti, a kurta
  \item a government office, a bus station, a blanket, a veranda, a broom
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A lid? (\textbf{\mr{झाकण}}, \emph{jhākaṇ}.) A jar? (\textbf{\mr{बरणी}}, \emph{barṇī}.) A spiced lentil curry? (\textbf{\mr{आमटी}}, \emph{āmṭī}.) A sprouted-bean curry? (\textbf{\mr{उसळ}}, \emph{usaḷ}.) A pickle? (\textbf{\mr{लोणचे}}, \emph{loṇce}.) Almonds? (\textbf{\mr{बदाम}}, \emph{badām}.) Raisins? (\textbf{\mr{मनुका}}, \emph{manukā}.) Jaggery? (\textbf{\mr{गूळ}}, \emph{gūḷ}.) A dhoti? (\textbf{\mr{धोतर}}, \emph{dhotar}.) A kurta? (\textbf{\mr{कुर्ता}}, \emph{kurtā}.) A government office? (\textbf{\mr{कचेरी}}, \emph{kacerī}.) A bus station? (\textbf{\mr{बसस्थानक}}, \emph{basasthānak}.) A blanket? (\textbf{\mr{पांघरूण}}, \emph{pāṅgharūṇ}.) A veranda? (\textbf{\mr{ओसरी}}, \emph{osrī}.) A broom? (\textbf{\mr{झाडू}}, \emph{jhāḍū}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 272-275 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:MR-R275-second-pass-words-from-chapters-272-275}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for justice and an entitlement.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item justice, an entitlement, a duty, responsibility, an opportunity
  \item a memory, temperament, behaviour, respect, pity
  \item good wishes, an invitation, a ceremony, worship, an officer
  \item a puzzle, a play, a film, dance, a stage
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Justice? (\textbf{\mr{न्याय}}, \emph{nyāy}.) An entitlement? (\textbf{\mr{हक्क}}, \emph{hakka}.) A duty? (\textbf{\mr{कर्तव्य}}, \emph{kartavya}.) Responsibility? (\textbf{\mr{जबाबदारी}}, \emph{jabābdārī}.) An opportunity? (\textbf{\mr{संधी}}, \emph{sandhī}.) A memory? (\textbf{\mr{आठवण}}, \emph{āṭhvaṇ}.) Temperament? (\textbf{\mr{स्वभाव}}, \emph{svabhāv}.) Behaviour? (\textbf{\mr{वागणूक}}, \emph{vāgṇūk}.) Respect? (\textbf{\mr{आदर}}, \emph{ādar}.) Pity? (\textbf{\mr{दया}}, \emph{dayā}.) Good wishes? (\textbf{\mr{शुभेच्छा}}, \emph{śubhecchā}.) An invitation? (\textbf{\mr{आमंत्रण}}, \emph{āmantraṇ}.) A ceremony? (\textbf{\mr{समारंभ}}, \emph{samārambh}.) Worship? (\textbf{\mr{पूजा}}, \emph{pūjā}.) An officer? (\textbf{\mr{अधिकारी}}, \emph{adhikārī}.) A puzzle? (\textbf{\mr{कोडे}}, \emph{koḍe}.) A play? (\textbf{\mr{नाटक}}, \emph{nāṭak}.) A film? (\textbf{\mr{चित्रपट}}, \emph{citrapaṭ}.) Dance? (\textbf{\mr{नृत्य}}, \emph{nṛtya}.) A stage? (\textbf{\mr{रंगमंच}}, \emph{raṅgmañc}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
